signals.threshold: 2 consecutive probes fail within 2 minutes
signals.response: Enable maintenance, verify the reviewed web digest, and select the prior compatible release if the current bytes differ.
signals.testMethod: Request the provider default root twice and compare the returned root digest with the release manifest.

signals.threshold: 2 consecutive /health probes fail within 2 minutes
signals.response: Enable maintenance, stop worker claims, and inspect the database and release health signals.
signals.testMethod: Force the synthetic health probe to fail and confirm the fixture enters the incident queue.

signals.threshold: 5 minute p95 exceeds 1000 ms
signals.response: Check database locks, connections, and recent deployment state before changing capacity.
signals.testMethod: Feed five minutes of synthetic durations with p95 above 1000 ms to the alert fixture.

signals.threshold: 5 minute HTTP 5xx ratio exceeds 5 percent with at least 20 requests
signals.response: Enable maintenance if failures persist for a second window, then preserve safe logs and choose a compatible rollback release.
signals.testMethod: Feed a synthetic 5xx sample above the ratio and minimum request threshold.

signals.threshold: 30 HTTP 401 or 403 responses in 5 minutes
signals.response: Review issuer, application-account, and role failures without recording subjects or tokens; open an incident if the rate persists.
signals.testMethod: Send synthetic denied requests and confirm only counts, status, time, and correlation IDs appear.

signals.threshold: 20 HTTP 429 responses in 5 minutes
signals.response: Check the affected rate class and trusted proxy state; do not raise a limit during an active incident.
signals.testMethod: Exhaust a synthetic fixed window and confirm the safe rejection signal and threshold fixture.

signals.threshold: 2 consecutive internal readiness probes fail within 2 minutes
signals.response: Enable maintenance and verify database reachability before restarting the reviewed Keycloak artifact.
signals.testMethod: Make the synthetic readiness endpoint unavailable for two probes.

signals.threshold: 20 failed synthetic-realm logins in 5 minutes
signals.response: Review brute-force state and recent identity changes using aggregate events only.
signals.testMethod: Replay sanitized Keycloak LOGIN_ERROR fixtures without usernames, email addresses, or client secrets.

signals.threshold: Any unreviewed JWKS key-ID set change
signals.response: Enable maintenance, preserve the prior and current key-ID digests, and verify the approved rotation record.
signals.testMethod: Compare synthetic prior and current key-ID digests with no matching rotation reference.

signals.threshold: Disk use reaches 75 percent or free space falls below 2 GiB
signals.response: Stop new work, review growth and the fixed-size cost plan, and obtain a new reviewed plan before resizing.
signals.testMethod: Evaluate a synthetic provider metric at both capacity boundaries.

signals.threshold: Active connections reach 80 percent of the provider limit for 5 minutes
signals.response: Identify the component count, drain stuck work, and keep maintenance enabled if new connections fail.
signals.testMethod: Feed a synthetic five-minute connection series at 80 percent.

signals.threshold: Any blocking lock remains for 60 seconds
signals.response: Enable maintenance, stop workers, record safe session identifiers, and end only the reviewed blocking operation.
signals.testMethod: Create a disposable synthetic blocking transaction and observe it for 60 seconds.

signals.threshold: Provider backup is failed, missing, or older than 26 hours
signals.response: Keep maintenance enabled and open an incident; Part 14F owns restore proof and no restore starts here.
signals.testMethod: Evaluate missing, failed, and 27-hour-old synthetic backup records.

signals.threshold: Stored bytes grow by 20 percent in 24 hours or approach 225 GiB
signals.response: Stop new bulk work, compare safe count and byte totals, and review cost before continuing.
signals.testMethod: Feed synthetic daily count and byte totals across both thresholds.

signals.threshold: 5 object-provider failures in 5 minutes
signals.response: Stop scanner and reconciler claims, preserve error-code counts, and verify private endpoint health.
signals.testMethod: Inject five synthetic provider errors without keys, URLs, or object bytes.

signals.threshold: Versioning is not enabled at any review
signals.response: Enable maintenance, stop object writes, and restore the reviewed private versioning configuration.
signals.testMethod: Validate a synthetic provider record with versioning disabled.

signals.threshold: Any ACL, key scope, or public-access state differs from the reviewed private contract
signals.response: Enable maintenance, revoke the changed key, preserve sanitized provider identifiers, and restore the reviewed scope.
signals.testMethod: Mutate a synthetic access record to public or account-wide access.

signals.threshold: No successful record by 02:00 Asia/Dubai for an approved business date
signals.response: Keep the missed scope recorded, run one controlled replay, and retain the business date and aggregate counts.
signals.testMethod: Omit a synthetic daily completion record past 02:00 Asia/Dubai.

signals.threshold: Any invocation exits nonzero
signals.response: Do not claim partial success; preserve the safe error code and retry only after the cause is reviewed.
signals.testMethod: Run the disabled and failed synthetic command paths.

signals.threshold: Heartbeat is older than 120 seconds
signals.response: Stop promotion, inspect worker health, and restart only the reviewed artifact with leases preserved.
signals.testMethod: Advance a synthetic heartbeat clock beyond 120 seconds.

signals.threshold: Oldest pending or retryable item exceeds 15 minutes
signals.response: Check heartbeat, lease, and provider failures before allowing more uploads.
signals.testMethod: Claim a disposable item created more than 15 minutes ago and inspect the safe age field.

signals.threshold: Any expired lease is recovered
signals.response: Verify a single recovery claim and confirm no duplicate successful scan mutation.
signals.testMethod: Expire one disposable lease and claim it once.

signals.threshold: 3 retries for one item or 10 retries in 15 minutes
signals.response: Pause new uploads when the aggregate threshold fires and review safe error-code counts.
signals.testMethod: Drive disposable scans through the fixed retry schedule.

signals.threshold: Any item reaches attempt 8
signals.response: Open an incident, preserve the safe audit record, and require manual review before requeue.
signals.testMethod: Drive a disposable scan to attempt 8 with a synthetic provider error.

signals.threshold: Heartbeat is older than 120 seconds
signals.response: Stop promotion, inspect worker health, and restart only the reviewed artifact with leases preserved.
signals.testMethod: Advance a synthetic heartbeat clock beyond 120 seconds.

signals.threshold: Oldest pending or retryable operation exceeds 15 minutes
signals.response: Stop new object mutations and inspect heartbeat, leases, and provider errors.
signals.testMethod: Claim a disposable operation created more than 15 minutes ago.

signals.threshold: Any expired lease is recovered
signals.response: Verify a single recovery claim and confirm no duplicate object mutation.
signals.testMethod: Expire one disposable operation lease and claim it once.

signals.threshold: 3 retries for one operation or 10 retries in 15 minutes
signals.response: Stop new object mutations when the aggregate threshold fires and review safe error-code counts.
signals.testMethod: Drive disposable operations through the fixed retry schedule.

signals.threshold: Any operation reaches attempt 8
signals.response: Open an incident, preserve the safe audit record, and require manual review before requeue.
signals.testMethod: Drive a disposable operation to attempt 8 with a synthetic provider error.

signals.threshold: Any migration, build, deploy, or component health step fails
signals.response: Keep maintenance enabled, stop workers, and select the prior compatible reviewed manifest.
signals.testMethod: Evaluate a failed synthetic deployment fixture and verify no automatic rollback or schema downgrade.

signals.threshold: Any running digest or schema head differs from the reviewed release manifest
signals.response: Enable maintenance and redeploy the exact reviewed manifest only after preserving drift evidence.
signals.testMethod: Change one synthetic running digest and compare it with the manifest.

signals.threshold: Any required backup record fails or misses its contracted schedule
signals.response: Keep maintenance enabled and open an incident; defer restore execution to Part 14F.
signals.testMethod: Evaluate failed and overdue synthetic backup fixtures.

signals.threshold: Actual monthly spend reaches USD 15 or USD 20
signals.response: Review current resources and variable charges; treat the account alert only as an early warning.
signals.testMethod: Evaluate synthetic spend at USD 15 and USD 20 and verify no spending-cap claim.

signals.threshold: Reviewed fixed plan or forecast exceeds the USD 15 owner usage cap, or a variable charge has no owner
signals.response: Block new work and provider mutation until the total reviewed plan is at or below USD 15 and every variable charge has one owner.
signals.testMethod: Validate synthetic plans at USD 15 and USD 15.01 plus an unowned variable charge.
